info.name: TMS Requisition API
info.description: List / Create / View / Edit / Cancel endpoints for the Vehicle Requisition module, plus an employee picker endpoint. Authenticated via a Bearer token: call `Auth > Login` first, which stores the returned token in the `token` collection variable; every other request inherits it and the API identifies the acting user from that token. Call `Auth > Logout` when done to destroy the token server-side and clear the `token` variable. For passenger_vehicle requisitions, `employee_id` must contain exactly `no_of_person` distinct, active employee ids — call `List Employees` first, which stores sample ids into the `employee_ids`/`employee_ids_alt` collection variables used by `Create Requisition - Passenger Vehicle` and `Update Requisition`. Set the `base_url` collection variable before running.

request.description: Logs in and stores the returned token in the {{token}} collection variable, used by every other request's inherited Bearer auth.

Destroys the authenticated user's API token server-side (acc_user_info.api_token and api_token_expires_at are set to null) and clears the {{token}} collection variable. Verified end-to-end: the same token gets a 401 Unauthenticated on any request made after this call.
Lists requisitions created by the authenticated user, optionally filtered by date range.
Returns the authenticated user's account info, resolved from the Bearer token.

Returns active employees (those with an acc_user_info account whose active_status = 'Active') for building the employee_id[] picker on passenger_vehicle requisitions. Saves the first two ids into {{employee_ids}} and the next two into {{employee_ids_alt}}, used by the Create/Update requests below.

request.description:
Creates a passenger_vehicle requisition. Body is the real, verified example from Requisition No 130826-2785 (id 2785, created via the web UI) with its 3 riders (employee ids 1036, 1404, 2872) — confirmed to store identically via this API. employee_id must contain exactly no_of_person distinct, active employee ids; swap in {{employee_ids}} (from List Employees) if these specific ids don't exist as active employees in your environment. Saves the new id into {{requisition_id}} for the following requests.

**Field options** (dropdown/radio in the web UI — the API rejects anything else with a 422):
- `requisition_for`: `Own User` | `Someone Else`
- `requisition_for_user`: `Internal User` | `External User` — only `Internal User` is allowed when `requisition_for` is `Own User`; either value is allowed when `requisition_for` is `Someone Else`
- `used_type`: `Pickup` | `Drop` | `Pickup & Drop`

request.description:
Creates a logistic_support requisition. No employee_id/no_of_person here — that concept only applies to passenger_vehicle. Saves the new id into {{logistic_requisition_id}}.

**Field options** (dropdown/radio in the web UI — the API rejects anything else with a 422):
- `requisition_for` (labeled **Vehicle Type** in the web UI for this requisition type — same field name as passenger_vehicle's `requisition_for`, different allowed values): `Cover Van` | `Open Truck`
- `loading_capacity`: `1∙5 Ton` | `2 Ton` | `3 Ton` | `5 Ton` | `7 Ton`
Returns full detail (driver/vehicle/audit log) for one requisition. 403 if the authenticated user isn't the creator.

request.description:
req_type must match the requisition's existing type exactly. For passenger_vehicle, employee_id replaces the full rider list and must again contain exactly no_of_person distinct, active employee ids (this example uses {{employee_ids_alt}} to demonstrate replacement, not addition). Only works while status is still Pending, and only for the original creator.

**Field options** (dropdown/radio in the web UI — the API rejects anything else with a 422). For a passenger_vehicle requisition (as in this example):
- `requisition_for`: `Own User` | `Someone Else`
- `requisition_for_user`: `Internal User` | `External User` — only `Internal User` is allowed when `requisition_for` is `Own User`
- `used_type`: `Pickup` | `Drop` | `Pickup & Drop`

For a logistic_support requisition, the same rules as Create Requisition - Logistics Support apply instead: `requisition_for` (**Vehicle Type**) is `Cover Van` | `Open Truck`, and `loading_capacity` is `1∙5 Ton` | `2 Ton` | `3 Ton` | `5 Ton` | `7 Ton`.
Only works while status is still Pending, and only for the original creator. Returns 409 if already cancelled/not pending.
no_of_person is 3 but only 2 employee_id entries are given. Expect 422 with an employee_id error: "The number of selected employees must equal no_of_person (3)."

Employee id 1785 has no active acc_user_info account in this dev DB (verified inactive/unlinked). Expect 422 with an employee_id error: "One or more selected employees are inactive or do not have an active user account." Replace 1785 with a known-inactive employee id in your own environment if this one doesn't reproduce it there.
employee_id 1036 is listed twice. Expect 422 (the `distinct` rule rejects it as "The employee_id.1 field has a duplicate value.").

request.description: requisition_for=Own User can only pair with requisition_for_user=Internal User (mirrors the web modal's JS, which never lets a user submit this combination). Expect 422 with a requisition_for_user error: "requisition_for_user must be 'Internal User' when requisition_for is 'Own User'."
